summary: Bank First Corp (BFC) filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire PSB Holdings, Inc. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock merger, with PSB shareholders receiving 0.3470 BFC shares per PSB share. The aggregate consideration is subject to downward adjustment if PSB's tangible book value falls below $122.8M at closing. Boards of both companies unanimously approved. PSB preferred stock will be purchased by BFC or converted into new BFC preferred shares. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and tangible book value calculations that could affect final consideration.
